fact: In May 2026 the Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation launched the first phase of a Hospital Management System at Al-Nau Hospital in Khartoum and the Al-Gadarif diagnostic centre, bringing together the patient record, laboratory, pharmacy, HMIS, surveillance, civil registration and HR systems.
title: Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation Launch the First Phase of the Healthcare Sector Digitization Program
